title: Residual weight distributions of vectorial dual-bent self-orthogonal codes
summary: Determine the complete weight distributions of the self-orthogonal codes from the source's Theorem 2 outside its explicitly solved cases.

formal_statement.body: Let $F:V_n^{(p)}\to\mathbb F_{p^m}$ be a vectorial dual-bent function satisfying Condition C and all hypotheses of Theorem 2, and let $\varnothing\ne I\subseteq\mathbb F_{p^m}$. Determine the complete weight distribution of the code $C_{D_F,I}$ for every admissible Theorem-2 parameter tuple not covered by Theorem 3. The separately named Wang--Heng family $C_{D_F,H_b}$ is tracked by the related record.

scope.domain: Self-orthogonal linear codes constructed from p-ary vectorial dual-bent functions
assumptions: F: V_n^(p) -> F_{p^m} is vectorial dual-bent and satisfies Condition C
Theorem 2 assumptions hold, including (A.1), t | m, (l-1)(d-1) = 1 mod (p^m-1), m < n/2, and the source binary restriction when p=2
I is a nonempty subset of F_{p^m}
Theorem 3 cases are excluded from the unresolved remainder
The separately named H_b family from Wang--Heng Theorem 23 is excluded and tracked separately
parameters: p, n, m, t, l, d
scope.unresolved_remainder: Exact weight distributions for all residual Theorem-2 cases and all nonempty I outside Theorem 3 remain unresolved. The named H_b subfamily is excluded here and tracked by the related record.

citations.label: Wang--Wei--Fu--Li, Self-Orthogonal Codes From Vectorial Dual-Bent Functions

progress.summary: The TIT source asks for exact weight distributions in the residual Theorem-2 cases and states that it only partially answers the antecedent problem.
